title: पञ्चमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 5 · The three go to the Pandava camp

summary.en: Kripa says that a man who will not hear his elders is ruined, and tells Ashvatthaman that his sleeplessness is the cause of his haste. Ashvatthaman insists, and the three go to the camp of the sleeping Pandava army.
summary.kn: ಹಿರಿಯರ ಮಾತು ಕೇಳದವನು ಹಾಳಾಗುತ್ತಾನೆ, ನಿನ್ನ ತರಾತುರಿಗೆ ನಿದ್ರಾಹೀನತೆಯೇ ಕಾರಣವೆಂದು ಕೃಪ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅಶ್ವತ್ಥಾಮ ಪಟ್ಟು ಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಮೂವರು ಮಲಗಿದ ಪಾಂಡವ ಸೈನ್ಯದ ಶಿಬಿರಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: कृप कहते हैं कि बड़ों की न सुनने वाला नष्ट होता है और अश्वत्थामा की जल्दबाज़ी का कारण उसकी अनिद्रा है। अश्वत्थामा अड़ा रहता है और तीनों सोई हुई पाण्डव सेना के शिविर की ओर जाते हैं।
summary.te: పెద్దల మాట వినని వాడు నశిస్తాడని, అశ్వత్థామ తొందరకు నిద్రలేమే కారణమని కృపుడు అంటాడు. అశ్వత్థామ పట్టుబడతాడు; ముగ్గురు నిద్రిస్తున్న పాండవసేన శిబిరానికి వెళతారు.
summary.ta: பெரியோர் சொல் கேளாதவன் அழிவான், உன் அவசரத்துக்குத் தூக்கமின்மையே காரணம் என்று கிருபர் கூற, அஸ்வத்தாமன் பிடிவாதம் பிடிக்க, மூவரும் உறங்கும் பாண்டவப் படையின் பாசறைக்குச் செல்கின்றனர்.
summary.ml: മുതിർന്നവരെ കേൾക്കാത്ത മനുഷ്യൻ നശിക്കുമെന്ന് കൃപർ പറയുന്നു; അശ്വത്ഥാമാവിന്റെ ഉറക്കമില്ലായ്മയാണ് അദ്ദേഹത്തിന്റെ തിടുക്കത്തിന് കാരണമെന്നും പറയുന്നു. അശ്വത്ഥാമാവ് വാശിപിടിക്കുന്നു; ഉറങ്ങിക്കിടക്കുന്ന പാണ്ഡവസേനയുടെ പാളയത്തിലേക്ക് മൂവരും പോകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 10.5; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Fri Oct 30 2026

verses.text: कृप उवाच

meaning.en: Kripa said:

verses.text:
शुश्रूषुरपि दुर्मेधाः पुरुषोऽनियतेन्द्रियः ।
नालं वेदयितुं कृत्स्नौ धर्मार्थाविति मे मतिः ॥

meaning.en: I think a dull-witted man with unrestrained senses, though he is willing to listen, is not able to grasp both dharma and profit in full.

verses.text:
तथैव तावन्मेधावी विनयं यो न शिक्षति ।
न च किंचन जानाति सोऽपि धर्मार्थनिश्चयम् ॥

meaning.en: Likewise even an intelligent man who has not learned humility knows nothing and cannot decide what is right and what is useful.

verses.text:
शुश्रूषुस्त्वेव मेधावी पुरुषो नियतेन्द्रियः ।
जानीयादागमान्सर्वान्ग्राह्यं च न विरोधयेत् ॥

meaning.en: But an intelligent man who is willing to listen and has his senses under control can learn all the teachings and does not oppose what is to be accepted.

verses.text:
अनेयस्त्ववमानी यो दुरात्मा पापपूरुषः ।
दिष्टमुत्सृज्य कल्याणं करोति बहुपापकम् ॥

meaning.en: But one who cannot be led, who is arrogant, wicked and sinful, discards what destiny offers and does great evil.

verses.text:
नाथवन्तं तु सुहृदः प्रतिषेधन्ति पातकात् ।
निवर्तते तु लक्ष्मीवान्नालक्ष्मीवान्निवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: Friends hold back a man who has protectors from sin; the fortunate man turns back, while the unfortunate one does not.

verses.text:
यथा ह्युच्चावचैर्वाक्यैः क्षिप्तचित्तो नियम्यते ।
तथैव सुहृदा शक्यो नशक्यस्त्ववसीदति ॥

meaning.en: Just as a distracted person is calmed by words of all kinds, so one with a friend can be restrained; one who cannot be restrained sinks.

verses.text:
तथैव सुहृदं प्राज्ञं कुर्वाणं कर्म पापकम् ।
प्राज्ञाः संप्रतिषेधन्ते यथाशक्ति पुनः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: In the same way, the wise repeatedly forbid, as best they can, a clever friend who is doing a wicked deed.

verses.text:
स कल्याणे मतिं कृत्वा नियम्यात्मानमात्मना ।
कुरु मे वचनं तात येन पश्चान्न तप्यसे ॥

meaning.en: So set your mind on what is good, restrain yourself by yourself, and follow my words, dear one, so that you do not suffer afterward.

verses.text:
न वधः पूज्यते लोके सुप्तानामिह धर्मतः ।
तथैव न्यस्तशस्त्राणां विमुक्तरथवाजिनाम् ॥

meaning.en: By dharma, killing the sleeping is not praised in the world, nor of those who have laid down their weapons or who have unyoked their chariots and horses.

verses.text:
ये च ब्रूयुस्तवास्मीति ये च स्युः शरणागताः ।
विमुक्तमूर्धजा ये च ये चापि हतवाहनाः ॥

meaning.en: Nor of those who say "I am yours," or who have come for refuge, or whose hair is loosed, or whose chariots are destroyed.

verses.text:
अद्य स्वप्स्यन्ति पाञ्चाला विमुक्तकवचा विभो ।
विश्वस्ता रजनीं सर्वे प्रेता इव विचेतसः ॥

meaning.en: Tonight, lord, the Panchalas will sleep with their armor off, all of them trusting and senseless as the dead.

verses.text:
यस्तेषां तदवस्थानां द्रुह्येत पुरुषोऽनृजुः ।
व्यक्तं स नरके मज्जेदगाधे विपुलेऽप्लवे ॥

meaning.en: The crooked man who wrongs them in that state will surely sink in a vast hell without a raft.

verses.text:
सर्वास्त्रविदुषां लोके श्रेष्ठस्त्वमसि विश्रुतः ।
न च ते जातु लोकेऽस्मिन्सुसूक्ष्ममपि किल्बिषम् ॥

meaning.en: You are renowned as the best among those who know all weapons, and there is not the slightest fault in you anywhere in this world.

verses.text:
त्वं पुनः सूर्यसंकाशः श्वोभूत उदिते रवौ ।
प्रकाशे सर्वभूतानां विजेता युधि शात्रवान् ॥

meaning.en: But tomorrow, when the sun has risen, you will shine like the sun and conquer your enemies in battle in the sight of all beings.

verses.text:
असंभावितरूपं हि त्वयि कर्म विगर्हितम् ।
शुक्ले रक्तमिव न्यस्तं भवेदिति मतिर्मम ॥

meaning.en: This blamable act is unthinkable in you; I feel it would be like a red stain placed on white cloth.

verses.text: अश्वत्थामोवाच

meaning.en: Ashvatthaman said:

verses.text:
एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वमनुशास्मीह मातुल ।
तैस्तु पूर्वमयं सेतुः शतधा विदलीकृतः ॥

meaning.en: What you say is so, uncle, and I accept your instruction; but they already shattered this bridge of dharma into a hundred pieces.

verses.text:
प्रत्यक्षं भूमिपालानां भवतां चापि संनिधौ ।
न्यस्तशस्त्रो मम पिता धृष्टद्युम्नेन पातितः ॥

meaning.en: Before the eyes of the kings, and in your presence too, my father, with his weapons laid down, was struck down by Dhrishtadyumna.

verses.text:
कर्णश्च पतिते चक्रे रथस्य रथिनां वरः ।
उत्तमे व्यसने सन्नो हतो गाण्डीवधन्वना ॥

meaning.en: Karna, best of charioteers, was killed by the wielder of the Gandiva when his chariot wheel had sunk, and he was in the worst plight.

verses.text:
तथा शांतनवो भीष्मो न्यस्तशस्त्रो निरायुधः ।
शिखण्डिनं पुरस्कृत्य हतो गाण्डीवधन्वना ॥

meaning.en: So too Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, with his weapons laid down and unarmed, was killed by the wielder of the Gandiva using Shikhandin as his shield.

verses.text:
भूरिश्रवा महेष्वासस्तथा प्रायगतो रणे ।
क्रोशतां भूमिपालानां युयुधानेन पातितः ॥

meaning.en: Likewise Bhurishravas, the great archer, who was fasting to death in the battle, was cut down by Yuyudhana while the kings cried out.

verses.text:
दुर्योधनश्च भीमेन समेत्य गदया मृधे ।
पश्यतां भूमिपालानामधर्मेण निपातितः ॥

meaning.en: Duryodhana, meeting Bhima in a mace fight, was felled unfairly in the sight of the kings.

verses.text:
एकाकी बहुभिस्तत्र परिवार्य महारथैः ।
अधर्मेण नरव्याघ्रो भीमसेनेन पातितः ॥

meaning.en: Alone, surrounded there by many great charioteers, that tiger among men was unfairly struck down by Bhimasena.

verses.text:
विलापो भग्नसक्थस्य यो मे राज्ञः परिश्रुतः ।
वार्त्तिकानां कथयतां स मे मर्माणि कृन्तति ॥

meaning.en: The lament of my king with broken thighs, which I heard from the messengers as they told it, cuts my vitals.

verses.text:
एवमधार्मिकाः पापाः पाञ्चाला भिन्नसेतवः ।
तानेवं भिन्नमर्यादान्किं भवान्न विगर्हति ॥

meaning.en: Such are the sinful, lawless Panchalas, who broke the bridge; why do you not blame them, who have so broken all bounds?

verses.text:
पितृहन्तॄनहं हत्वा पाञ्चालान्निशि सौप्तिके ।
कामं कीटः पतंगो वा जन्म प्राप्य भवामि वै ॥

meaning.en: Having killed the Panchalas, the slayers of my father, in a night attack, I would gladly be born as an insect or a moth.

verses.text:
त्वरे चाहमनेनाद्य यदिदं मे चिकीर्षितम् ।
तस्य मे त्वरमाणस्य कुतो निद्रा कुतः सुखम् ॥

meaning.en: I am in a hurry today over this thing I mean to do; and for me in my haste, where is sleep, where is ease?

verses.text:
न स जातः पुमाँल्लोके कश्चिन्न च भविष्यति ।
यो मे व्यावर्तयेदेतां वधे तेषां कृतां मतिम् ॥

meaning.en: No man has been born in this world, nor will be, who could turn me from this resolve to kill them.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा महाराज द्रोणपुत्रः प्रतापवान् ।
एकान्ते योजयित्वाश्वान्प्रायादभिमुखः परान् ॥

meaning.en: Having spoken thus, O great king, the mighty son of Drona yoked his horses apart and set out facing the enemy.

verses.text:
तमब्रूतां महात्मानौ भोजशारद्वतावुभौ ।
किमयं स्यन्दनो युक्तः किं च कार्यं चिकीर्षितम् ॥

meaning.en: The two great-souled ones, the Bhoja and the descendant of Sharadvat, said to him, "Why is your chariot yoked, and what do you intend to do?

verses.text:
एकसार्थं प्रयातौ स्वस्त्वया सह नरर्षभ ।
समदुःखसुखौ चैव नावां शङ्कितुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: We two set out with you in common cause, best of men, and share your pain and pleasure; you should not doubt us."

verses.text:
अश्वत्थामा तु संक्रुद्धः पितुर्वधमनुस्मरन् ।
ताभ्यां तथ्यं तदाचख्यौ यदस्यात्मचिकीर्षितम् ॥

meaning.en: But Ashvatthaman, furious, remembering his father's death, told them truthfully what he intended.

verses.text:
हत्वा शतसहस्राणि योधानां निशितैः शरैः ।
न्यस्तशस्त्रो मम पिता धृष्टद्युम्नेन पातितः ॥

meaning.en: "After killing hundreds of thousands of warriors with sharp arrows, my father, with his weapons laid down, was struck down by Dhrishtadyumna.

verses.text:
तं तथैव हनिष्यामि न्यस्तवर्माणमद्य वै ।
पुत्रं पाञ्चालराजस्य पापं पापेन कर्मणा ॥

meaning.en: I will kill that sinful son of the Panchala king in the very same way, with his armor off, repaying his wicked deed with a wicked deed.

verses.text:
कथं च निहतः पापः पाञ्चालः पशुवन्मया ।
शस्त्राहवजितां लोकान्प्राप्नुयादिति मे मतिः ॥

meaning.en: And I think that if that sinner of a Panchala is slain by me like a sacrificial beast, he will reach the worlds of those who die by weapons in battle.

verses.text:
क्षिप्रं संनद्धकवचौ सखड्गावात्तकार्मुकौ ।
समास्थाय प्रतीक्षेतां रथवर्यौ परंतपौ ॥

meaning.en: Quickly, armored and with swords and bows in hand, mount your fine chariot, you two tormentors of the foe, and wait."

verses.text:
इत्युक्त्वा रथमास्थाय प्रायादभिमुखः परान् ।
तमन्वगात्कृपो राजन्कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः ॥

meaning.en: Having said this, he mounted his chariot and set out toward the enemy, and Kripa and Kritavarman of the Satvatas followed him, O king.

verses.text:
ते प्रयाता व्यरोचन्त परानभिमुखास्त्रयः ।
हूयमाना यथा यज्ञे समिद्धा हव्यवाहनाः ॥

meaning.en: Setting out, the three, facing the foe, shone like kindled sacrificial fires being invoked at a sacrifice.

verses.text:
ययुश्च शिबिरं तेषां संप्रसुप्तजनं विभो ।
द्वारदेशं तु संप्राप्य द्रौणिस्तस्थौ रथोत्तमे ॥

meaning.en: They went to the camp of the enemy, where the people lay fast asleep, lord; arriving at the gate, the son of Drona halted in his fine chariot.
